scope: All seven original content photos actually viewed in fourteen readable halves, with original dimensions and hashes verified. Boundary page180 excluded. Text-only source examples and pictures remain unadopted.

pages.observation: fan noun/verb and fanned/fanned; zero plural zeros/zeroes and above/below zero; toy-with verb; robotic printed adjective; ant colony and ants-in-pants idiom.

pet/petted/petted, ham, born time/place/family and born-to constructions, world and worldwide. The printed Jackie/art-world Chinese means ignorance of non-art matters, whereas English describes her fame only inside the art world; no running textbook example has been adopted.
frog and hoarse-throat idiom; homework/assignment/schoolwork; juice/juicy; lazy/laziness/lazily/lazybones; plural clothing nouns pants/shorts/jeans and denim.
skirt/miniskirt; dress clothing and food-preparation verbs, dresses and dressed; dressing/clothe; rainbow/bow; bug insect/software/annoyance/listening-device uses and bugged/bugged; kite.
kind adjective/noun and kinda; kindness and yummy; banana split; cellphone variants; telephone/phone/call; test noun/verb and blood test.

grade noun/verb/graded; mathematics/math; parent singular versus parents plural, son/daughter and in-law forms; write/wrote/written with writing/rewrite. Printed introduce-you-to-daughter Chinese correctly follows the English direction; no proposed correction.

writer/author; weather noun/verb and under-weather idiom, climate/weather countability teaching note; sunny/rainy and rainy-day reserve idiom; file noun/verb and file-a-lawsuit. The running examples remain unadopted.
